name: China New Consumption Group Limited
summary: China New Consumption Group Limited (Holding) Company Limited, an investment holding company, provides foundation work and ancillary services in Hong Kong and Macau. The company undertakes bored piling and other foundation works. It also offers management services for construction works; and machinery rental and leasing services. China New Consumption Group Limited (Holding) Company Limited was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong.
